name: Sam-A Aluminium Company, Limited
summary: SAM-A ALUMINIUM Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of rolled, drawn, and folded aluminum products. It operates through Rolling, Processing, and Electronic Parts business divisions. The Rolling business division provides aluminum foil for packaging and other materials. The Processing business division offers adhesive thin paper. The Electronic Parts business division includes USB storage devices. The company was founded on June 25, 1969 and is headquartered in Pyeongtaek-si, South Korea.
